definitions.explanation: The anticipated outcome or future possibility.
The likelihood that something will happen.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{見込|みこ}みは{明|あか}るい。
examples.english: The outlook for this year is bright.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}は{前年|ぜんねん}の20%{増|ぞう}の{見込|みこ}みです。
examples.english: Sales are expected to increase by 20% from last year.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}は{来月|らいげつ}{完成|かんせい}の{見込|みこ}みで、{予定|よてい}{通|どお}り{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: The construction is expected to be completed next month and is proceeding on schedule.

examples.japanese: {回復|かいふく}の{見込|みこ}みがない。
{彼|かれ}は{見込|みこ}みのある{若者|わかもの}だ。
{成功|せいこう}の{見込|みこ}みは{低|ひく}いが、やってみる{価値|かち}はあると{思|おも}う。
examples.english: The chances of success are low, but I think it's worth trying.

notes:
FORMATION:
{見込|みこ}む (to anticipate) → {見込|みこ}み (noun form)

USAGE:
・{見込|みこ}みがある (there's hope/a chance)
・{見込|みこ}みがない (there's no hope)
・{見込|みこ}み{違|ちが}い (miscalculation, misjudgment)
・{見込|みこ}み{客|きゃく} (prospective customer)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{成功|せいこう}の{見込|みこ}み (chance of success)
・{完成|かんせい}の{見込|みこ}み (expected completion)
・{見込|みこ}み{通|どお}り (as expected)
